name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 4 visits over 28 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2026-06-11, at wavelengths from 1.68 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
